branding.tagline: Role-based AI adoption dashboards for Gemini Enterprise, Gemini for Workspace and Antigravity: executive decisions, change-management opportunities, product telemetry, value scenarios, governance and data health. Built on the BigQuery tables produced by the Gemini analytics pipeline.

gemini_project.label: BigQuery Project ID
gemini_project.description: GCP project that holds the gemini_analytics dataset (your data lake project).

gemini_dataset.label: Gemini analytics dataset
gemini_dataset.description: BigQuery dataset that holds export_history. Leave as gemini_analytics unless you renamed it.

workspace_dataset.label: Workspace audit dataset (optional)
workspace_dataset.description: BigQuery dataset holding the Workspace Gemini audit log export. Set it to the dataset name created by the Workspace Admin console; the value is only used if you enable Workspace reporting.

workspace_export.label: Workspace audit export
workspace_export.description: none, separate_region or same_region. Use same_region when the Workspace audit dataset is in the same BigQuery location as the Gemini analytics dataset (or copied there): this turns on Gemini for Workspace adoption, the Workspace population and org units. Use separate_region if it lives elsewhere: only the Workspace Gemini tab uses it. Use none if you have no Workspace export.

employee_domains.label: Employee domains
employee_domains.description: Optional comma-separated list of email domains that count as employees, for example example.com,example.co.uk. Leave blank to include all domains.

excluded_org_units.label: Excluded org units
excluded_org_units.description: Optional BigQuery regular expression for Workspace org-unit paths to exclude from employee adoption rates, for example (?i)external|guest.

excluded_email_pattern.label: Excluded email pattern
excluded_email_pattern.description: BigQuery regular expression for service accounts or non-human accounts to exclude from employee adoption rates. Defaults to common service-account and noreply patterns. Avoid backslashes: write a literal dot as [.].

reporting_time_zone.label: Reporting time zone
reporting_time_zone.description: IANA time zone for hour-of-day charts, for example Europe/London or America/New_York. Defaults to UTC.

power_user_min_days.label: Power user threshold (days)
power_user_min_days.description: AI-active days in the trailing 28 days that make someone a Power user. Default 12, about three days a week.

normal_user_min_days.label: Normal user threshold (days)
normal_user_min_days.description: AI-active days in the trailing 28 days that make someone a Normal user. Default 4, about once a week. Fewer is Casual; zero is Non-AI.

health_min_prompts.label: Service Health minimum prompts
health_min_prompts.description: Minimum prompts before failure-rate thresholds can make Gemini Service Health Down. The same minimum applies before Model Armor rejection rate can make the status Degraded. Default 20.

health_down_failure_rate.label: Service Health Down failure rate
health_down_failure_rate.description: Prompt failure-rate threshold for Down status. Use a decimal: 0.25 means 25%. Default 0.25.

health_degraded_failure_rate.label: Service Health Degraded failure rate
health_degraded_failure_rate.description: Prompt failure-rate threshold for Degraded status. Use a decimal: 0.05 means 5%. Default 0.05.

health_degraded_connector_rate.label: Service Health connector error rate
health_degraded_connector_rate.description: Connector errors divided by prompts threshold for Degraded status. Use a decimal: 0.10 means 10%. Default 0.10.

health_degraded_armor_rate.label: Service Health Model Armor rejection rate
health_degraded_armor_rate.description: Model Armor rejection-rate threshold for Degraded status. Model Armor cannot make the status Down. Use a decimal: 0.10 means 10%. Default 0.10.

ge_seat_cost_monthly.label: Gemini Enterprise monthly seat cost
ge_seat_cost_monthly.description: Per licence, in your currency. Leave 0 to hide spend figures.

gws_seat_cost_monthly.label: Gemini for Workspace monthly seat cost
gws_seat_cost_monthly.description: Per Workspace user, if Gemini is billed separately. Leave 0 if it is bundled or you don't want it in value tiles.

loaded_hourly_rate.label: Loaded hourly rate
loaded_hourly_rate.description: Fully loaded cost of an hour of employee time, used to value estimated time saved. Leave 0 to show hours only.

currency_symbol.label: Currency symbol
currency_symbol.description: Shown on spend and value figures. Defaults to $.

time_saved_minutes.label: Minutes saved per AI action
time_saved_minutes.description: Comma-separated feature=minutes pairs used for the time-saved estimate, for example default=2,Deep Research=30,help_me_write=5. Features not listed use default.

time_saved_low_factor.label: Low scenario factor
time_saved_low_factor.description: Multiplier applied to estimated hours saved for the low productivity-benefit scenario. Default 0.5.

time_saved_high_factor.label: High scenario factor
time_saved_high_factor.description: Multiplier applied to estimated hours saved for the high productivity-benefit scenario. Default 1.5.

use_case_mapping.label: Use-case mapping
use_case_mapping.description: Comma-separated feature=Use Case pairs for business-facing reporting, for example help_me_write=Drafting & Editing. Features not listed use the default value.

org_unit_depth.label: Org-unit depth for departments
org_unit_depth.description: How many segments of the Workspace org-unit path make a department: 1 for /Sales, 2 for /EMEA/Sales. Default 1.

interventions_table.label: Interventions table
interventions_table.description: BigQuery table in the Gemini analytics dataset containing optional intervention records. Defaults to ai_interventions.

value_outcomes_table.label: Value outcomes table
value_outcomes_table.description: BigQuery table in the Gemini analytics dataset containing optional validated outcome records. Defaults to ai_value_outcomes.

interventions_form_url.label: Intervention input form URL
interventions_form_url.description: Optional link to the form or app your change team uses to record interventions, such as a Google Form or AppSheet app that writes to the interventions table. Leave as none to hide the Record an intervention button.
